how_to_apply: Visit the Current Opportunities section of the official Bank of Baroda website.
Open the relevant recruitment page for the Faculty or Financial Literacy Counsellor post.
Download and read the detailed advertisement.
Download the prescribed application form available with the recruitment notice, where provided.
Complete the application form with personal, educational and experience details.
Attach the documents required in the application form and official career-page instructions.
Submit the application through the mode and address prescribed on the relevant official recruitment page.
Complete the submission on or before the latest closing date displayed by Bank of Baroda.
important_instructions: Candidates must apply separately for the relevant post. The Faculty applicant must satisfy the prescribed age, educational and skill requirements. The FLC applicant must possess the required banking or related experience. The maximum age for the FLC post is 64 years at the time of application. Applicants should follow the latest deadline displayed on the Bank of Baroda career portal. All information entered in the application must match the supporting certificates. Candidates should keep copies of the application form and submitted documents.

content_sections.heading: Post-Wise Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a graduate or postgraduate qualification in any discipline, including Science, Commerce or Arts. Preference may be given to candidates possessing any of the following qualifications: Master of Social Work MA in Rural Development MA in Sociology MA in Psychology BSc in Veterinary Science BSc in Horticulture BSc in Agriculture BSc in Agricultural Marketing BA with BEd Flair for teaching Sound computer knowledge Excellent communication skills in the local language Local-language typing skills Fluency in English and Hindi will be an added advantage Hindi or English typing skills will be an added advantage Previous experience as Faculty will be preferred Conduct sessions on entrepreneurship, motivation, personality development and business management. Conduct business games and guide trainees. Coordinate the institute's training programmes. Conduct Entrepreneurship Awareness Programmes and other pre-training activities. Generate applications and assist with candidate selection. Assist the Director in designing the Annual Action Plan and training programmes. Arrange training materials, logistics and Guest Faculty. Conduct post-training follow-up meetings and visits. Provide counselling, credit linkage and project-report preparation support. Prepare success stories and send at least two stories every month to the controlling office or Ministry of Rural Development. Prepare post-programme, monthly and periodical reports. Guide the Office Assistant in maintaining the Day Book, General Ledger and other registers. Develop new training programmes based on emerging business opportunities. Prepare case studies and training materials. Maintain coordination with external agencies. Assist the Director with internal administration and control. Organise functions, events and institute meetings. Prepare press releases and reports on institute activities. Supervise the work of the Assistant, Attender and Watchman-cum-Gardener. Monitor the performance of Guest Faculty. Maintain the institute's inventory and library books. Oversee the maintenance of classrooms, kitchen, dining area, dormitory and other campus facilities. Maintain discipline and ensure that regular institute activities are conducted. Perform other duties assigned by the Director. Candidates must satisfy one of the following experience conditions: Former bank employee with at least five years of experience in a nationalised bank, Regional Rural Bank or private bank; or At least five years of experience in banking, a related sector, NBFC or financial institution; or Former Business Correspondent, BC or BF with at least five years of experience; or Former RSETI Director or Faculty with at least three years of experience. Provide financial counselling through face-to-face interaction, email, mobile and other available communication channels. content_sections.heading: Nature of Engagement
content_sections.text: Both the Faculty and Financial Literacy Counsellor positions are offered on a contractual basis. The place of engagement is Mariyani, Chaubepur, Kanpur Nagar, under Bank of Baroda's Lucknow Zone and Kanpur Nagar Region.

content_sections.text: Completed prescribed application form Recent passport-size photograph Proof of date of birth Graduation or postgraduate certificates Academic mark sheets Experience certificates Relieving, retirement or service certificate for former bank employees Computer or typing qualification details, where applicable Valid identity proof Other documents required in the official application form

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must apply separately for the relevant post. The Faculty applicant must satisfy the prescribed age, educational and skill requirements. The FLC applicant must possess the required banking or related experience. The maximum age for the FLC post is 64 years at the time of application. Applicants should follow the latest deadline displayed on the Bank of Baroda career portal. All information entered in the application must match the supporting certificates. Candidates should keep copies of the application form and submitted documents.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in Bank of Baroda Faculty and FLC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Two vacancies are available: one Faculty post and one Financial Literacy Counsellor post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The attached advertisements mention 7 October 2026. The latest official career listings display 9 October 2026 as the closing date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Faculty post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates or postgraduates in any discipline. Preference may be given to applicants with qualifications in social work, rural development, sociology, psychology, agriculture, horticulture, veterinary science, agricultural marketing or education.

faq.question: Q4. Who can apply for the Financial Literacy Counsellor post?
faq.answer: A graduate who is a former bank employee or has the prescribed experience in banking, NBFCs, financial institutions, business correspondence or RSETI can apply.

faq.question: Q5. Where are the Faculty and FLC posts located?
faq.answer: Both posts are located at Mariyani, Chaubepur, Kanpur Nagar, under Bank of Baroda's Lucknow Zone.
